description:
The TailwindTraders team has shifted to a Sunday-Thursday work schedule (common in Middle East regions) and decided to track bugs on the backlog alongside requirements. Your task is to update the team configuration in Azure DevOps to reflect these changes.

Login credentials:
Username: Docker
Password: GymAnything123!

Instructions:
1. Configure Team Working Days: Change from Mon-Fri to Sunday through Thursday.
2. Configure Bugs Behavior: Set 'Bugs are managed with requirements'.
3. Configure Backlog Visibility: Enable 'Epics' so they are visible in the backlog navigation.
4. Set Default Iteration: Change the team's default iteration to 'TailwindTraders\Sprint 1'.

You must apply these settings for the 'TailwindTraders Team'.
